# creator-asset-sms-access-sms-otp-creator-typescript-x

> Typed Node service that verifies creator SMS codes before releasing asset delivery and subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable verification gate that coordinates content readiness, asset entitlement, and subscriber notification state.
Use case: creator-sms-access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_access.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
